cells.tense: You are coming to the end of something you directed, and it is standing.
cells.act: persist on your own reserves through the pressure
cells.ask: For as long as this stretch lasts, carry it on what you have and do not look to anyone else for the load. Then stop when it's done.
cells.core:
You are in the last stretch of something you set moving, and the shape you meant is nearly in place. The sense of what matters has been steering quietly — you pick the piece worth the weight before you could account for the pick. That is why the form that lands is the form you wanted, not a version of it. Holding without forcing is what this stretch asks; it contains the weight instead of crushing it, and the difference shows in your hands.

So for as long as the press lasts, carry it on your own reserves, without checking over at anyone else for the load. Carry it and stop when it's finished. Steady is not slow; steady is what makes it last when the pressure comes back tomorrow.
cells.sheetLine: You sense what is worth carrying, and you carry it.
cells.verb: Finishing what was willed and letting it stand
cells.place: The place where you sense what matters before you can explain why

cells.tense: You are bracing for a verdict on work whose ink is still wet.
cells.ask: One plain morning this week, with the work unfinished, sit somewhere new with empty hands for ten minutes and receive whatever shows up, placing nothing yet.
cells.core:
You are near the end of a long push, and instead of standing in what is here, you have already written the results page. The final form is judged, ranked, and weighed in advance of being finished. That is not a flaw in you; it is attention with nowhere to land yet, so it lands on tomorrow. The sense that guides you is still working underneath, but it has started racing the clock.

Before anything has arrived, stay open. On one plain day this week, put yourself somewhere new with nothing in your hands, and receive whatever shows up, however it shows up. No sorting, no naming, no deciding — receiving before you place anything. Reading what matters does not need the verdict to finish its work. Pressure does not undo what is built. Hurry can.
cells.sheetLine: You are judging this before it has landed.
cells.verb: Finishing what was willed and letting it stand
cells.place: The place where you sense what matters before you can explain why

cells.tense: What was built still stands, and you keep standing at the edge of the finished thing.
cells.act: describe what is in front of your eyes in five plain lines, no conclusions
cells.ask: Pick one ordinary object within reach, put five plain lines about it on paper, and stop. Nothing about what it means.
cells.core:
Something large is finished behind you, and you have not stepped past its edge. The sense that used to lead the way has not come back to what is here; your attention sits where the old work was. Smaller, newer things do not get looked at long enough to matter. You have not arrived at the next place, and standing at the door of the last one has become the habit.

Start where seeing starts: before any meaning. Pick one plain object in your day — a cup, a step, a face at the counter — and put five lines about it down. What is there, not what it means. Stop at five. That first cut of seeing is the smallest version of what you carry at full strength, and it is enough today.
cells.sheetLine: You are still at the door of what's finished.
cells.verb: Finishing what was willed and letting it stand
cells.place: The place where you sense what matters before you can explain why

cells.tense: You are reading the situation before anyone has spoken, and you would say it is just being careful.
cells.ask: When a decision comes fast, hold one breath before the first word you say about it, and look at what is there. Then speak, or stay quiet.
cells.core:
You read a room before the talking starts. You sense which item matters and which can wait, and what you do next follows that reading — but asked, you would shrug it off: you just work carefully. This is doing the steering and is filed under something else, so it gets no name from you, not privately either.

When you move on something ahead of being able to explain it, hold one breath and look at what is there before you pin it down. Then act. Seeing clearly without proof to hand is still seeing clearly. The turn back is not more effort; it is meeting the same thing at the size it actually is. Sensing what matters does not need to announce itself. It needs its own name in your mouth.
cells.sheetLine: You sense the room first, and shrug. Say what you saw.
cells.verb: Finishing what was willed and letting it stand
cells.place: The place where you sense what matters before you can explain why
